name: Shattering-Cover Projection VC Dimension of Trivial Concepts
proof: A one-coordinate projection is the full one-cube, so it is admissible and has VC dimension one. The empty projection has one shattered subset, fewer than the two concepts in the class; thus no admissible projection has VC dimension zero. This is checked by $\texttt{sync/verify\_interpolation\_conjecture.py}$.
